subject: general
question: The Ravan Phadi cave in _________ is an example of the early Chalukya style architecture which is known for its distinct sculptural style.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravan Phadi **cave is located in** Aihole**, in the **Bagalkot district of Karnataka, India**.
 
• This site is renowned for its historic temples and structures from the early **Chalukya dynasty,** which ruled the region from **the 6th to the 12th centuries.**
 
• **The Ravan Phadi cave** is a notable example of early Chalukya architecture, featuring intricate rock-cut sculptures and carvings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu:**

 
 
• It is located in the **southernmost part of India, Tamil Nadu is known for its Dravidian-style Hindu temple**s.
 
• The state has a rich history of empires such as** the Chola, Pallava, Pandya, and Chera.** 
 
 
 
• **Kerala**:
 
 
• This southwestern Indian state is known for its scenic beauty including its backwaters, palm-lined beaches, and a network of canals.
 
• In addition, it has a rich cultural heritage with its own unique architecture and temple designs, often associated with the **ancient Chera Empire and later feudal kingdoms.**
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh: **
 
 
• It is Located in southeastern India, Andhra Pradesh has a history that dates back to the Vedic period.
 
• It has been ruled by several major Indian dynasties such as **the Maurya, Satavahana, and Chalukya**. 
 
 
 
• **Karnataka: **
 
 
• It is Located in the southwestern region of India, Karnataka was home to some of India's most powerful empires, such as the** Chalukya, Rashtrakuta, Hoysala, and Vijayanagara.**
 
• **The Ravan Phadi cave**, an example of early **Chalukya architecture,** is located in **Aihole in the Bagalkot district of Karnataka.**
